lines.say: Here's Israel at true size: 22,072 square kilometres.
West Bank and Gaza shaded, not counted. Now, let's go far.
Greenland: 98. Almost the same as Saudi Arabia.
The Sahara: about 390. Its edges are fuzzy, so call it an estimate.
And Antarctica: 643 Israels of ice. The biggest drop of all.
Every copy is true size, even at the South Pole.
Size isn't everything. Plenty of this is ice and sand.
Where on Earth should I drop Israel next?

caption_en:
The biggest one isn't a country. 🗺️

Israel at true size: 22,072 km², incl. the Golan Heights and East Jerusalem (Israel Central Bureau of Statistics, 2023). West Bank and Gaza shaded, not counted.

How many times it fits:
🇬🇱 Greenland 2,166,086 km²: 98x (Saudi Arabia is about 100x)
🇦🇺 Australia 7,692,024 km²: 348x
🇧🇷 Brazil 8,510,417 km²: 386x
(UN Statistics Division, Demographic Yearbook 2024)
🏜️ The Sahara, about 8.6 million km² (Britannica): about 390x. Its edges are fuzzy, so treat it as an estimate.
🧊 Antarctica, about 14.2 million km² (Britannica, NASA): about 643x

Every copy is drawn at true size for its latitude, even at the South Pole (equal area map, no Mercator stretch).

Size isn't everything. Plenty of this is ice and sand.
Where on Earth should I drop Israel next?

Part 4 of 4. Part 1 (the neighbours) on my profile.

caption_he: גרינלנד: פי 98, כמעט כמו סעודיה. אוסטרליה: פי 348. ברזיל: פי 386. הסהרה: בערך פי 390 (הגבולות שלה לא חדים, אז זו הערכה). אנטארקטיקה: בערך פי 643. גודל זה לא הכול. הרבה מזה קרח וחול. לאן בעולם להפיל את ישראל בפעם הבאה?
